$comment: The model names a role job may launch with (epoch 3 E1 s4, from the finding of s3: claude 2.1.330 does NOT refuse an unknown model name - it runs the DEFAULT model and bills it, measured twice, about 1.62 USD; see v2/epoch-3/e1-role-jobs-ba/stories/s3-router-failover/SIGNALS.md section 6). coai-mcp embeds this file (src_mcp/core/CoaiMcp.Core.csproj, core/Roles/RoleModelNames.cs) and the router refuses a name that is not here BEFORE a folder or a launch is made, naming the setting that holds it (COAI_ROLES_MODELS, COAI_ROLES_BANDS, or the model argument of start_role). claude: the four CLI aliases and the full ids of claude.verifiedIds - NEVER an id by its shape, because a typo of a real id (claude-opuss-5-5, claude-sonet-5-5, claude-opus-5-55) has the same shape and the CLI would run and bill its default model; it is the only vendor that bills a typo. codex and agy: only names from these lists; a name is added here when it is measured (a recording in src_mcp/tests/fixtures/role-stops/ or a result under research/) or when .agents/rules/common/vendor-routing.md names it; the `source` of each list says which. Both of those CLIs refused an unknown model before any paid call (codex-bad-model.json, agy-bad-model.json), so for them this list costs a refusal, not money.

claude.source: aliases: the four the CLI documents and shared/role-defaults.json uses. verifiedIds: ONLY full ids seen as real in output of the claude CLI (a recording, a real transcript, or a measurement under research/); the source of each is on its row. An id that is not listed is refused before any launch, even when it looks right, because the CLI runs and bills its default model for a name it does not know.
claude.howToAdd: To add a newly verified full id: (1) get the id from the CLI itself - run `claude --model <alias> -p ... --output-format json` once and read the key of `modelUsage` (or read `message.model` in a real transcript); do not copy it from a web page or type it; (2) add { "id": ..., "source": ... } to verifiedIds with the file or measurement that shows it; (3) add the id to the accepted rows of ARoleModelNameIsCheckedBeforeAnyLaunchTests; (4) build and run the whole MCP suite. Never add a pattern.
